thesis: Operator runtimes and evaluation frameworks are commoditizing, so a technical contribution benefits their maintainers without near-term return, adopting an incumbent is cheaper but fixes no live failure, and doing nothing with these signals is correct; the only supported operational test benefits Will by resolving the stalled auto-close decision, with continuation contingent on a commit-backed implementation and a review cycle showing no false close or stale resurface, while the commercial hypothesis that buyers value verified false-close rates remains deferred.
doctrine: Research changes Shadow only when it resolves a live decision or produces measured operational benefit; repeated signals without changed outcomes are suppressed rather than converted into more infrastructure.
